author: hattrill
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000088634
[POLYCOMB GROUP RING FINGER PROTEIN (PTHR45893)](http://www.pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR45893)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
l(3)73Ah, FB:FBgn0002283 (Siesta) 
GO:0035102 PRC1 complex

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

PMID:41790891 shows that there are different RING1-containing complexes and that FBgn0002283 is not part of a canonical Polycomb PRC1 complexes (that contain Psc and Su(z)2 act at PRE-containing Polycomb target loci) and is part of a different ubiquitin ligase complex that may modify chromatin but not at the same sites as PRC1.

Changing the CC annotation to GO:0000152 nuclear ubiquitin ligase complex and/or GO:0031519  PcG protein complex would be more accurate.
title: PAINT issue:Not all Polycomb group RING finger proteins are prt of canonical PRC1 complex

author: marcfeuermann
body: Indeed the term was annotated to the root of the family tree. Probably because these complexes are often called PCR1-like complexes. I made the correction following your suggestion.
